content: <thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₁₀H₁₂NO₄ (exact monoisotopic mass 210.0766 Da, ~36 ppm from the observed value, the closest reasonable candidate). Therefore the molecular formula is C10H12O4N, written in the required CxHyOzX format.
